doc.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Working briefly with Buddy Rich's small group
summary: McKenna later worked with Buddy Rich in a small group with Mike Mainieri and Selden Powell.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. About 8. A small group then. And then later on I did work with Buddy briefly, with a small group.
Oh, I remember — I have a picture of that.
I’m trying to remember the name of the album because I remember seeing you in that picture now. Do you like the big band context as a piano player?
